FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What orthodontic treatments are available at the Riccobene location in Garner?

Orthodontics can correct a vast array of dental conditions, such as crowding, protruding/poorly spaced teeth, overbites, underbites and other misalignments. At Riccobene, we can help you treat them all.

Do you treat children and teens in Garner?

Yes - family dental care is available at our Garner location. Bring the whole family for exceptional care so the whole family is smiling bright.

Can teens and adults get Invisalign® in Garner?

Yes - both teens and adults can get Invisalign® at our Garner location. Schedule an initial consultation to see whether Invisalign® is the best option for your orthodontic needs by giving us a call.

When should my child see an orthodontist?

The American Association of Orthodontists recommends that a child see an orthodontist for the first time around age 7 to assess your child’s dental development. They can begin assessing tooth spacing or crowding, alignment, underbites, overbites, and more as adult teeth grow in.

Do you accept dental insurance or membership plans for orthodontics in Garner?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How do I schedule a free orthodontic consultation in Garner?

Give us a call to schedule your first appointment and we’ll get you on the schedule as fast as possible. You can reach our office at (919) 661-6161.

Are braces available for children in Garner, NC?

Yes, braces are available for children. The age at which it’s appropriate for your child to get braces will depend on their oral development and the severity or nature of problems to be corrected. Our experts can help you understand what is (or isn’t!) happening with your child’s dental development and build a plan.

What types of clear aligners (like Invisalign®) are offered in Garner?

Riccobene offers Invisalign® and others, as well as clear aligners depending on your specific needs.
